summary: You ground an answer in numbered sources: rules in the system prompt, sources with their citations in the user message, and a code check that finds invented citations. A simulated writer lets you run it with no key. You also meet a question your search cannot answer yet.
goal: Return an answer plus the source names.

items.text: Add grounding.py and SimulatedWriter, run ask_with_sources.py and match the answers and the Sources lines
Ask another question, predict its citation, then open the page it points to
Remove the check and see why an invented source is worse than none
Ask the E104 question with retrieve and write down what the top 3 show
Play the Source Checker game to the end and see your score
